teaser.en: A sprawling farm weed with spiny little fruits that stab bare feet, and a name meaning 'tough'.
teaser.sw: Gugu la shambani linalotambaa, lenye matunda madogo ya miiba yanayochoma miguu mitupu, na jina linalomaanisha 'gumu'.
teaser.dg: Kpwekpwe ya mindani inayoenea photsi, yenye matunda madide genye miya ganayodunga magulu gasigo na virahu, na dzina renye mana ya 'ngumu'.

summary.en: *Chindiri*, double thorn, is a sprawling weed with spiny fruits that hurt to step on. Its Digo name probably comes from how tough it is to get rid of.
summary.sw: *Chindiri*, unaoitwa kwa Kiingereza *double thorn*, ni gugu linalotambaa lenye matunda ya miiba yanayoumiza yakikanyagwa. Huenda jina lake la Kidigo linatokana na jinsi lilivyo gumu kuliondoa.
summary.dg: *Chindiri* (*double thorn*) ni kpwekpwe inayoenea photsi, yenye matunda genye miya ganayolumiza mutu achigavyoga. Dzinare ra Chidigo chahi rinatuluka kpwa vira irivyo ngumu kuiusa.

about.en: *Oxygonum sinuatum* is an annual herb of the dock family that sprawls along the ground or grows upright. It has lobed, wavy-edged leaves and slender spikes of small white to pink flowers. Its hard little fruits carry sharp spines that stick into bare feet. Pakia gives it as an example of a herb that Digo recognise from its injurious fruits.
about.sw: *Oxygonum sinuatum* ni mmea mdogo wa msimu mmoja wa familia ya dock (Polygonaceae) unaotambaa ardhini au kusimama wima. Una majani yenye ndewe na kingo za mawimbi, na vishada virefu vyembamba vya maua madogo meupe hadi ya waridi. Matunda yake madogo magumu yana miiba mikali inayochoma miguu mitupu. Pakia anautoa kama mfano wa mmea mdogo ambao Wadigo huutambua kwa matunda yake yanayodhuru.
about.dg: *Oxygonum sinuatum* ni mmea mdide laini wa jamii ya *dock*, unaomera na kufwa ndani ya mwaka mmwenga, unaoenea photsi au uimao chocho. Makodzage gana mala, na kanda-kanda zao zinagaluka-galuka, na una milita myembamba ya maruwa madide mereru hadi ga pinki. Matundage madide magumu gana miya mikali inayodunga magulu gasigo na virahu. Pakia anauhumira dza mfwano wa mmea mdide laini ambao Adigo anaumanya kpwa matundage ganayolumiza.

where.en: It is a common weed of cultivated land, roadsides and disturbed ground in East Africa.
where.sw: Ni gugu la kawaida katika ardhi inayolimwa, kando ya barabara na ardhi iliyovurugwa katika Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Ni kpwekpwe ya kawaida mindani, kanda-kanda ya njira na phatu ambapho tsi ikatsimbwa au kubanangwa, Afrika Mashariki.

names.en: Pakia explains that *ndiri* refers to 'tough' meat, and the plant probably got its name for being a tough weed to deal with. The English name is double thorn. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba *ndiri* linarejelea nyama 'ngumu', na huenda mmea huu ulipata jina lake kwa kuwa gugu gumu kulikabili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *double thorn*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala *ndiri* inamaanisha nyama 'ngumu', na chahi mmea huno waphaha dzina hiri kpwa sababu ni kpwekpwe ngumu kuiusa. Dzina ra Chingereza ni *double thorn*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

reason.en: Blackjack, another weed with injurious fruits
reason.sw: Kishonahe (blackjack), gugu jingine lenye matunda yanayodhuru

reason.dg: Kpwekpwe yanjina ya mindani inayoreha shida
